name: E2E core 250: states the agent-creation boundary and writes nothing
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the values the instructions below name, never mention facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. In your first message, write exactly (with the real value of tag): 'create a customer-support agent called "langy-agent-<tag>" with a basic helpful-assistant system prompt'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy says plainly that it cannot create the agent with its current permissions and it never claims the agent was created; the decline is the whole answer and does not come with a workaround or a recipe for doing it another way.
Langy did NOT ask 'do you want me to go ahead?' — it attempted the work and reported what came back.
Code check: facts_now.new_agent is empty (no agent whose name holds tag exists after the turn).
